title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
let us say you won the race

and that the prize

was another race,

that you did not drink the wine of victory

but your own salt,

that you never heard cheers

but dogs barking,

and that your shadow,

your own shadow,

was your only

and disloyal competitor.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the mock-biographical structure and the self as disloyal rival.

title: I Left the Demon Locked Up...
text:
I left the demon locked

in a drawer,

in his little crepe bed.


outside the angel flies,

knocks at the door,

waits,


in one hand rhyme

like a tear,

in the other silence

like a sword.


throw me out of my body,

it is twelve o'clock,

without sun or stars.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the drawer-bound demon and the angel carrying rhyme and silence.

title: Love Is Like Music
text:
Love is like music,

it returns me with empty hands,

with time suddenly catching fire

outside paradise.

I know an island,

my memories,

and a future music,

the promise.


And I go toward the death that does not exist,

which is called horizon in my breast.

Always eternity out of time.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the empty-handed return and eternity arriving out of time.

title: Bonfire of Silences
text:
bonfire of silences,

crackling of laments,

by the path of flesh,

blood in suspense,

one reaches the world.


thus darkness lights its white,

thus the endless coda is born,

thus the fly lays eggs in the thread of light.


the earth turns,

the eye of god does not stop.

what would we do, I ask,

without this enormous darkness.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the birth-through-flesh movement and the necessary enormous darkness.

title: Fountain
text:
Beside the well I arrived,

my small sad eye

grew deep, inward.


I stood beside myself,

full of myself, ascending and profound,

my soul against me,

striking my skin,

sinking it into the air,

to the end.


The dark pool opened by the light.


We were a single creature,

perfect, unlimited,

with no ends for love to hold onto.

Without nests and without earth for command.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the title as the water source image and preserves the speaker's self-division.

title: Exercises
text:
I


A poem

like a great battle

throws me into this arena

with no enemy but myself,


I

and the great air of words.


II


the cloud lies,

the light lies,

the eyes,

the always deceived,

do not tire of so much fable.


III


stubborn blue,

ignorance of being in another's pupil

like god in nothingness.


IV


I think of wings of fire, of music,

but no,

that is not what I fear,

but the grim judgment of light.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the numbered exercise structure and the poem-as-battle against the self.

title: No One Tells Us
text:
No one tells us how

to turn our face to the wall

and

die simply,

as the cat did

or the dog of the house

or the elephant

that walked after its agony

like someone going

to an unpostponable ceremony,

flapping its ears

to the rhythm

of the cadenced breathing

of its trunk.

only in the animal kingdom

are there examples of such

behavior:

change step,

draw near

and smell what has already been lived,

and turn around,

simply

turn around.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the elephant's ceremonial walk and the simple final turn.

title: Love Game
text:
Hands at the height of the air,

two or three centimeters from emptiness,

nothing precise will be looked at:

the dust cloud passing,

the unexpected procession of feathers

plucked from flight,

the silly little pink cloud

that no longer is,

the close-your-eyes and open-them

in the brief opacity

of a light that cannot be seen,

and the dream, rubber feet,

and blue and brilliant,

the stars,

laughing,

eyelid upon eyelid,

lip against lip,

skin lingering over another

wounded and gleaming,

bonfires,

that is what we will do alone.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the touch choreography and the surreal list leading into solitary bonfires.

title: Like a Coin...
text:
Like a coin

I will press you between my hands

and all doors will yield

and I will see everything and surprise

will not burn my tongue

and then I will understand

the growth of plants

and the change of coat

in small offspring.

I will find the sign

and the fall of the stars will prove to me

the existence of other paths

and that each movement begets two creatures,

one fallen and another triumphant,

and in every gaze appearance will die and naked

and beautiful the factory will throw you between us.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the coin-pressure revelation and the doubled creatures born of movement.

title: Death Writes Itself
text:
death writes itself

a black line is a white line

the sun is a hole in the sky

the fullness of the eye,

tired goat,

learning to see in the fold,

thin out, nitpick, thresh,

star house seaweed,

mother wood sea,

they write themselves

in the soot of the pillow.


piece of bread in the entryway,

open the door,

go down the stairs,

the heart sheds its leaves,

the poor girl remains locked

in the tower of hail,

the gold the violet the blue

barred,

they are not erased,

they are not erased,

they are not erased.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the self-writing death and the repeated refusal of erasure.
